notes: Detailed player-facing mechanics for KOTOR Campaign Guide Gladiatorial Combat and Melee Duelist talent trees.

rules.name: Brutal Attack
rules.description: Deal an additional weapon die when a selected weapon breaks an opponent's damage threshold.

feats: Weapon Focus (selected weapon or weapon group)
special: Proficient with selected weapon or group

mechanics.trigger: An attack with the selected weapon deals damage equal to or greater than the target's damage threshold.
mechanics.effect: Add one weapon-damage die to that attack.
mechanics.special: Repeatable for different exotic weapons or weapon groups.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 44

rules.name: Call Out
rules.description: Make one opponent affected by Personal Vendetta substantially less accurate against anyone else.

mechanics.target: One enemy affected by that use.
mechanics.effect: That enemy takes -5 on attacks against targets other than you instead of Personal Vendetta's normal -2.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 44

rules.name: Distracting Attack
rules.description: A damaging hit can distract the target and reduce its Reflex Defense.

mechanics.trigger: Deal damage with a melee or ranged attack using the weapon selected for Brutal Attack.
mechanics.check: Compare the existing attack roll against the target's Will Defense.
mechanics.effect: If the attack roll also equals or exceeds Will, target takes -2 to Reflex Defense.
mechanics.duration: Until end of your next turn.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 44

rules.name: Exotic Weapons Master
rules.description: Treat all exotic weapons as one group so existing exotic-weapon feats apply to every one of them.

special: Proficient with at least one exotic weapon

mechanics.effect: All exotic weapons become one weapon group for you. A feat that grants proficiency with or improves one exotic weapon instead grants that benefit to all exotic weapons.
mechanics.special: For example, one Exotic Weapon Proficiency or Weapon Focus selection becomes proficiency or focus for the exotic-weapons group.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 44

rules.name: Lockdown Strike
rules.description: Stop a moving opponent when your attack of opportunity connects.

mechanics.trigger: Hit a moving opponent no more than one size category larger than you with an attack of opportunity.
mechanics.effect: Immediately end that opponent's current movement.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 44

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Exotic Weapons)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple attacks with exotic weapons.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple attacks with exotic weapons as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 45

rules.name: Personal Vendetta
rules.description: Taunt nearby enemies into focusing their attacks on you.

mechanics.target: All enemies within 12 squares and line of sight.
mechanics.effect: On each target's next turn, it takes -2 on attacks made against anyone other than you.
mechanics.duration: Through each affected enemy's next turn.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 45

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: Reduce the condition-track movement caused by one debilitating hit.

mechanics.trigger: An attack hits and would move you down the condition track.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the number of condition steps moved by 1, minimum 0. Damage and other effects resolve normally.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 45

rules.name: Advantageous Strike
rules.description: Exploit an opponent's movement with highly accurate melee opportunity attacks.

mechanics.trigger: Make an attack of opportunity with a melee weapon you are proficient with.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Dirty Tricks
rules.description: Feint rapidly against an opponent you threaten.

mechanics.effect: Use the feint application of Deception against that opponent.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Dual Weapon Flourish I
rules.description: Follow one standard-action attack with a free strike from your second light weapon.

mechanics.use: Free action after the qualifying standard-action attack.
mechanics.trigger: While wielding only two light melee weapons or two lightsabers, make one standard-action attack with one weapon.
mechanics.effect: Make one attack with the other weapon, applying the normal two-weapon penalties.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Dual Weapon Flourish II
rules.description: Complete a two-weapon full attack as a standard action.

mechanics.trigger: Wield only two light melee weapons or two lightsabers.
mechanics.effect: Make a full attack, provided you attack with both weapons; apply the normal two-weapon penalties to the attacks.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Master of Elegance
rules.description: Use Dexterity instead of Strength for damage with light melee weapons.

special: Dual Weapon Flourish I or Single Weapon Flourish I

mechanics.effect: Add Dexterity bonus instead of Strength bonus to damage with a light melee weapon. When wielded two-handed, apply twice Dexterity bonus instead of twice Strength bonus.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Multiattack Proficiency (Advanced Melee Weapons)
rules.description: Reduce full-attack penalties when making multiple attacks with advanced melee weapons.

mechanics.trigger: Make multiple attacks with advanced melee weapons as a full attack.
mechanics.effect: Reduce the multiple-attack penalty by 2 per selection.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Out of Nowhere
rules.description: Capitalize on a successful feint with an immediate light-weapon attack.

mechanics.use: Free action on your turn, once per encounter.
mechanics.trigger: You successfully feint against an opponent.
mechanics.effect: Make one attack with a light melee weapon or lightsaber.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Single Weapon Flourish I
rules.description: Move freely during a full attack made with one light weapon.

feats: Double Attack (Advanced Melee, Exotic Melee, or Lightsabers)

mechanics.trigger: Make a full attack while wielding only one light melee weapon or one lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Move up to your speed as a free action at any point during your turn.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47

rules.name: Single Weapon Flourish II
rules.description: Make a single-weapon full attack as a standard action.

feats: Double Attack (Advanced Melee, Exotic Melee, or Lightsabers)

mechanics.trigger: Wield only one light melee weapon or one lightsaber.
mechanics.effect: Make a full attack instead of spending a full-round action.

source.name: Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide, p. 47
